Reviewer notes: hook 2: the cover names both biggest dairy brands, has a rupee range and a date (prices change tomorrow morning), over unmistakable Amul crates: a clear household stake in one second, even though a Rs 2-4 rise is not surprising in itself. read 1 (the weak check): slide 2's two bullets are mirror images of the same arithmetic (Gold Rs 120 / Taaza Rs 60 a month), and slide 4 leans on GCMMF's own messaging (80% reaches farmers, its list of costs) rather than something the reader acts on, so not every line earns the next; slides 2-3 are otherwise tight. send 2: a specific reason to forward tonight: the family member who pays the milkman or a Delhi-NCR relative, since rates per product change from 12 Nov. keep 2: per-product new rates (Mother Dairy full cream/toned/cow, Amul Gold/Taaza increments), the effective date and the last-rise date. reply 2: 'How many litres of milk does your home get through in a week?' is the only question, answerable from readers' own lives, not bait. original 2: idly's own synthesis (both brands' statements combined, the monthly household maths, the sourcing made explicit), own design, Unsplash photo credited on card and in caption. alone 2: cover gives who/what/how much/when; slides name brands, products and units; attribution on each slide; makes complete sense without the caption.
